title: agents --update-instructions appends the Quest block without removing the Backlog.md CRITICAL_INSTRUCTION it is meant to replace
description: A workspace migrated off Backlog.md via 'migration backlog apply' predictably still carries the Backlog.md-installer's CRITICAL_INSTRUCTION block in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md ('For every user request in this project, run backlog instructions overview before answering or taking action'). 'quest agents --update-instructions' only appends its own managed Quest block next to that -- it does not detect or remove the Backlog block, even though the migration path it pairs with (quest migration backlog apply) exists specifically to retire that tracker. The result: a session obeying both blocks calls a dead tracker on every turn. 'quest agents --check --require-installed' reports state: current in this exact condition -- it is honest about its own managed block and silent about the contradiction two lines away. Found during the 2026-09-03 five-repo fleet cutover: quest-cli, opum-doc, opum-agent, and opum-cli-e2e all hit this; opum-agent's own report of a clean run turned out to depend on the operator having hand-removed the Backlog block before running the command, which is exactly the shape of a tool whose correct-looking result depends on manual work already done. Scoped to the one competing directive this tool's own migration path guarantees will be present -- the Backlog.md installer's block, which has explicit BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES START/END markers and needs no prose parsing -- not a general foreign-directive detector.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Running --update-instructions in a workspace that has completed a Backlog migration (or otherwise carries a BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES START/END-delimited block) either removes that block or leaves --check reporting something other than state: current until it is addressed
If removal is the chosen fix: it is bounded to the delimited BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES block and does not touch unrelated content
If detection rather than removal is the chosen fix: --check surfaces the contradiction (a distinct state or a validation finding), not state: current
A test exercises a fixture AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md carrying the Backlog block, runs --update-instructions, and asserts the chosen behavior
The command help documents the chosen behavior
